name: Time Leap Paradise
original_name: タイムリープぱらだいす
source:
Next year is the 100th building anniversary of Hamagase Shrine, the shrine building is very old. They want to have it repaired, but they don't have enough money. 

The protagonist and his friends hear it and decide to earn money. Ayumu comes up with an idea, "How about holding a festival every weekend and earn money?" As a main event of the festival, they plan to carry out a concert and dance show...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
明年是滨濑神社建成一百周年，但神社建筑已经十分老旧。众人想对其进行修缮，却没有足够的资金。

主人公和朋友们得知此事后，决定一起筹钱。步提出一个主意：“每个周末都举办祭典来赚钱怎么样？”他们计划把演唱会和舞蹈表演作为祭典的主要活动…

[摘自ErogeShop]
